data: Which pruning method achieves the highest development accuracy at a prune percentage of 0.8?

The question asks which pruning method achieves the highest development accuracy at a prune percentage of 0.8. From the caption, we know that the blue line represents models pruned during pre-training, the orange line represents models with information deletion during pre-training, the green line represents models pruned after downstream fine-tuning, and the red line represents models pruned randomly during pre-training. 

Looking at the left graph, the blue line (prune pretrain) is consistently above the other lines across all prune percentages, including 0.8. Therefore, the blue line represents the highest development accuracy at a prune percentage of 0.8.
